capabilities: Intercept images pasted or dropped into notes
Dither images to black and white with five algorithms
Adjust threshold, sharpness, brightness, contrast, and resize per image
Apply presets or auto-pick the smallest output
Save output as PNG with a templated, deduplicated filename
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; output format is fixed to PNG and saved to the attachment location configured in Obsidian preferences.
problem: Pasted and dropped images are saved at full size and color, quickly growing vault storage with files that are often used only as illustrations.
summary: Image processing plugin that intercepts pasted or dropped images, dithers them to black and white, and resizes them to save storage space.
